description: Re-apply the project's current version: the same images, deployed again. This is the restart, and it is also the ONLY way a secret that was entered after the last deploy reaches the running containers — a value sits in the store doing nothing until a deploy re-pins the secret set version. Call it after a human has filled in the form behind get_secrets_link on a project that is already running.
name: restart
title: Restart the project
